title: File:A Zodiac Maritime Agencies Lpg Ship Part Of The Fleet Amassed (33494087).jpeg
desc: 500px provided description: An LPG ship carrying chemicals around the globe. The ship is part of Zodiac Maritime Agencies? fleet of vessels. Owned by shipping magnate, the company is chaired by Eyal Ofer. The LPG carriers are able to transport large volumes of liquefied petroleum gas (LPG) en masse.

title: File:Mooring of the LPG Tanker BW Cedar at the Kwinana Bulk Terminal, September 2020 18.jpg
desc: Mooring of the LPG Tanker BW Cedar at the Kwinana Bulk Terminal, Western Australia. The ship is assisted by two tug boats, the Svitzer Harrier and Svitzer Albatross. In front of the ships, the disused BHP Jetty Number 1 can be seen.
